 EBay Stock Jumps As Strong Q3 Results Add To E-Commerce Momentum 
 Licensing 
 RYAN DEFFENBAUGH 
 04:39 PM ET 10/28/2026
 EBay (EBAY) stock rose Wednesday after the e-commerce company's third-quarter results exceeded expectations. The online marketplace company also guided for a strong holiday quarter. San Jose, Calif.-based eBay reported adjusted earnings of $1.51 per share for the September-ended quarter, up 12% from a year earlier.
